initial_receipt.explanation: The two-job execution contains a provenance-ranking fault. The stipulated behaviour requires deterministic source provenance in demand-descending rank order. Job 1 selected and retained all eight qualifying records, but its provenance assembly ranked records by ascending demand_score, producing ranks n06-r08, n06-r07, ..., n06-r01. Job 2 then consumed the exact handed-off evidence_sources and preserved that upstream provenance order when ranking unsupported needs, so the downstream top recommendation reflects the faulty upstream ranks rather than a downstream handoff or coverage fault.
